jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Workforce Productivity
jobs.description:
This role focuses on analyzing and monitoring labor performance to ensure operational efficiency and cost control. The position involves tracking labor metrics against budget, identifying trends and variances, and supporting forecasting and reporting efforts. It plays a key part in maintaining accurate data, improving reporting processes, and helping leadership address underperforming or over-budget jobs. The role also collaborates closely with operations, finance, and field leadership teams to drive performance improvements while supporting job setup, account onboarding, and ongoing labor planning.

Overall, it’s a data-driven, entry-to-mid level analytical role that blends finance and operations, offering exposure to cross-functional teams and opportunities to grow in workforce planning, performance management, and business analysis.

**Benefit Information:** ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

Pay: $80,000-$100,000  
The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s  
education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.  
You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

* Track and report daily and weekly labor performance vs. budget
* Analyze labor data to identify variances, trends, and cost-saving opportunities
* Support forecasting and monitoring of labor hours, productivity, and expenses
* Assist in identifying and escalating over-budget jobs to leadership
* Maintain accuracy of labor and operational data, including square footage, scope of work, and labor hours
* Support job setup and closeout processes, ensuring proper labor coding and cost tracking
* Assist with onboarding new accounts by validating labor assumptions and inputs
* Monitor overtime, temp labor, and scheduling inefficiencies to identify improvement opportunities
* Participate in performance review processes and help track corrective actions
* Maintain reporting tools, dashboards, and data files to support decision-making
* Ensure data integrity by identifying and resolving discrepancies
* Support process improvements to enhance reporting efficiency and visibility
* Assist with branch and account performance analysis, including identifying drivers of underperformance
* Collaborate with operations and finance teams to support performance improvement efforts
* Provide timely and accurate ad hoc analysis as needed
* Report directly to the Sr Director of Workforce Productivity
* Provide analytical and operational support to the Sr Director of Workforce Productivity
* Partner closely with District Managers and Branch Managers to support day-to-day labor performance and execution
* Collaborate with the FP&A to align reporting, forecasting, and financial insights
* Work cross-functionally with operations and finance teams to support business performance

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related field
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with data tools a plus
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively

**Success Metrics**

* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
* Quality and usefulness of analysis
* Improvement in data integrity and reporting processes
* Contribution to labor cost optimization efforts

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience.

ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

  

ABM is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including disability and protected veteran status. ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888-328-8606. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

  

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.

  

ABM is a military-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military. With ABM, you’ll have access to a world-class training program and ample opportunities to use the skills you developed while serving our country. Whether you’re looking for a frontline or professional position, you can find post-military career opportunities across ABM.

  

ABM directs all applicants to apply at www.abm.com/careers. ABM does not accept unsolicited resumes or submissions outside of this portal. Applicants should submit their application by clicking Apply Now.

For more information, visit www.abm.com

jobs.title: Medicaid Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Career level compliance position that supports the compliance program activities and deliverables of a Medicaid managed care organization. In partnership with and under the direction of the health plan Compliance Officer and other team members, this position will help develop and maintain systems and processes that demonstrate the principles of an effective Compliance program and promote compliant and ethical behavior in our Medicaid health plans.

  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Maintain the systems and tools to track, monitor, review, and submit required regulatory and compliance related deliverables and responses to state Medicaid agencies on or before required due dates; prepares basic regulatory reports as needed on behalf of the Medicaid compliance team
* Assist with research and recommendations to help develop compliant business operations, processes and policies in accordance with state specific Medicaid program requirements
* Develop compelling and appropriate compliance related communications on behalf of the health plan in response to state Medicaid agency inquiries or requests
* Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of the health plan’s contractual, regulatory, and program policy related obligations as a Medicaid managed care organization and serve as a resource to health plan and growth partner staff for education and business decision making purposes
* Support the external audit review process in conjunction with designated subject matter experts at the health plan, including, but not limited to the project management and tracking of required deliverables, responses, and corrective action plan development (through closure)
* Maintain current resource tools and other internal deliverables such as current contract library, regulatory reporting assignments, risk assessments, risk tracking lists, internal reporting systems and summaries, and other department wide tools as needed to ensure the appropriate monitoring and oversight of health plan compliance processes
* Utilize systems unique to job functions, including standard-issue software such as Microsoft products and compliance specific tools such as Archer; maintain system documentation, serve as subject matter expert, train users of system, contribute to system design, oversight or maintenance
* In partnership with other senior members of the team, support oversight and monitoring activities to evaluate levels of compliance with Medicaid managed care organization requirements across the business; support business partners in the development of mitigation and corrective action plans and effectively escalate risks, concerns and other issues through appropriate channels
* Maintain positive, productive relationships with internal and external constituents to effectively communicate and influence ethical and compliant outcomes
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications**

  

* 2+ years of regulatory compliance experience in managed care, healthcare, or insurance; or a Master's degree.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience with Medicaid or Medicaid managed care
* Project Management experience
* Audit experience

**Education**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$43,888.00 - $102,081.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, B2B (Buyer and Seller Tech)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

**About the Company**

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

**Role Summary**

Fanatics Collect is a marketplace for trading cards and collectibles. A growing share of our supply and demand comes from businesses: hobby shops listing thousands of items, dealers managing thousands of cards on behalf of collectors, and breakers buying in volume.

We're looking for a Senior PM to build the B2B side of the Marketplace: the tools, agentic APIs and partner integrations that make Fanatics Collect the best place for professional sellers and buyers to do business at scale.

**What You'll Own**

* **Pro Seller:** tools for high-volume sellers to list, price, manage and fulfill inventory at scale, with corresponding analytics to help them optimize their business.
* **Pro Buyer:** bulk buying and API access for volume buyers, including automated buying against predefined criteria.
* **Agentic commerce:** make Fanatics Collect the marketplace AI agents are built for, from agent-ready APIs and integrations with AI assistants to on-site agentic buying and selling experiences.
* **Partner integrations:** integrations across the Fanatics ecosystem to offer sellers more distribution channels and help them get their inventory in front of millions of sports fans.
* **Operating at scale:** build automated solutions for onboarding new hobby shops, enforcing quality controls, etc.
* **Strategy and execution:** set success metrics, priorities, and partner with design, engineering, Commerce, Finance, Ops and Sales to ship.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including marketplace or commerce products.
* Experience with platform or API products or partner integrations; comfortable with technical tradeoffs and working closely with engineers.
* Track record of taking a new, ambiguous area from problem definition to shipped product.
* Data fluent: sets metrics, reads the data, makes the call.
* Comfortable in a fast-moving, cross-functional org
* AI-first: builds with AI every day (prototyping, analysis, specs) and looks for where AI can reshape the product, not just speed up the work.

*Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers*

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

*Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.description:
### **About Crane:**

  

### **Crane Aerospace & Electronics supplies critical systems and components to the aerospace and defense markets. You’ll find Crane Aerospace & Electronics in some of the toughest environments: from engines to landing gear; from satellites to medical implants and from missiles to unmanned aerial systems (UAS).**

### **Every 1.2 seconds, product built at our Crane Aerospace & Electronics Burbank facility is stopping aircraft – delivering passengers and military personnel safely to their destination. Home to our Landing & Cabin Systems team, Crane A&E’s brake control systems and premium cabin actuation solutions are flying on tens of thousands of aircraft throughout the world. You’ll join a business with a long track record of engineering excellence, set in the wonderful town of Burbank filled with great community atmosphere, schools, weather and no shortage of entertainment.**

### **Start the next chapter of your career with Crane Aerospace & Electronics!**

  
  

### **Job Summary:**

  

### **The Buyer Planner II - Aftermarket R&O is responsible for managing all aspects of purchasing components from suppliers in order to assure timely delivery of parts to support production needs. In addition, the Buyer Planner II is the communication and logistics link between stakeholders such as Value Streams, Supervisors, Marketing, Master Scheduler, and Purchasing.**

  
  

### **Scope of job responsibility:**

  

* ### **Responsible for effectively coordinating the planning of customer repair units to support the Aftermarket organization; includes oversight, purchase requisition placement and reschedules.**

* ### **Champion new ideas and processes to improve efficiency, cost reduction, and on-hand inventory.**

* ### **Knowledge of industry supply chain best practices and innovations related to delivery performance, cost management, material handling, and lead time reduction**

* ### **Demonstrated ability to work effectively in teams and with all management levels in a dynamic environment**

* ### **Strong interpersonal and communications skills**

* ### **Strong decision-making ability and creative problem solving skills**

* ### **Experience: 2+ years of experience buying in a similar industry or demonstrated equivalent knowledge of supply chain function through work experience or school**

* ### **Education/Certification: BA or BS degree in Supply Chain, Business, or Materials-related field desired**

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst I
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We’re actively seeking a talented Senior Financial Analyst I to join our Financial Planning and Analysis team in Newport Beach, CA. As a Senior Financial Analyst I you’ll move Pacific Life, and your career, forward by analyzing Life Insurance and Annuity earnings results compared to Plan. This role requires innate curiosity to understand the underlying stories and business drivers of our results, combined with technical expertise to leverage Pacific Life's financial systems for maximum impact and efficiency. You will fill an existing role that sits on a team of 5 people in the Consumer Markets Division (Annuities and Life Insurance). Your colleagues will include Financial Analysts, Actuaries, and other Finance professionals. This team collaborates extensively with Valuation, Sales, Expense, and Investment areas to craft and communicate a comprehensive business driver story of results for internal management.

**How you’ll help move us forward:**

  

* Facilitate the quarterly close process for GAAP and STAT Internal Management reporting requirements for Life, including:
  + Provide timely, relevant, and accurate findings/research to Consumer Markets Division (“CMD”) Finance, mainly around variances to Plan by business driver
  + Analyze CMD historical trends by product line to validate Plan assumptions and identify anomalies in current period results
  + Compile periodic CMD data for rating agency surveys and internal management dashboards
* Facilitate continuous process improvement for CMD Finance by evaluating current procedures and recommending value-added improvements
* Use best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve services and solve long-term problems
* Work with experts (both within Pacific Life and externally) to consider options and identify solutions that best align with business strategies.
* Develop solutions to complex problems with minimal supervision, requiring the regular use of ingenuity and creativity

**The experience you bring:**

  

* 5+ years financial reporting and analysis experience, preferably in the Life Insurance and Annuity industry
* Proven leadership, organizational, interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrates organizational, time management, project management, oral and written communications, and multi-tasking skills
* Adaptable to using/understanding various system functionalities including Microsoft Office products. Excel proficiency is a non-negotiable requirement, though VBA programming is not required
* Strong team building, partnership and collaboration skills
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize/communicate conflicting demands in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work independently on assignments of various levels of complexity

**What makes you stand out:**

* CPA, CMA, or MBA preferred
* Proficiency in Oracle, Essbase, Alteryx, Tableau, and Workiva is a plus

**You can be who you are.**

People come first here. We’re committed to an inclusive workforce. Learn more about how we create a welcoming work environment at www.pacificlife.com. What’s life like at Pacific Life? Visit Instagram.com/lifeatpacificlife.

#LI-TM1

**Base Pay Range:**

The base pay range noted represents the company’s good faith minimum and maximum range for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation offered to a candidate will be dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location. Also, most employees are eligible for additional incentive pay.

$103,140.00 - $126,060.00

**Your Benefits Start Day 1**

Your wellbeing is important to Pacific Life, and we’re committed to providing you with flexible benefits that you can tailor to meet your needs. Whether you are focusing on your physical, financial, emotional, or social wellbeing, we’ve got you covered.

* Prioritization of your health and well-being including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellbeing Reimbursement Account that can be used on yourself or your eligible dependents
* Generous paid time off options including: Paid Time Off, Holiday Schedules, and Financial Planning Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave as well as an Adoption Assistance Program
* Competitive 401k savings plan with company match and an additional contribution regardless of participation

**You Can Be Who You Are**

We are committed to a culture of diversity and inclusion that embraces the authenticity of all employees, partners and communities. We support all employees to thrive and achieve their fullest potential.

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

SuperAnnotate helps the world’s leading AI teams build responsible, next-generation models powered by high-quality human data. We’re a fast-growing Series B startup bridging the gap between advanced AI innovation and the data that drives it. Our global network of expert specialists, scalable managed operations, precise talent matching, and full project transparency ensure unmatched data quality at scale. Trusted by innovators like Databricks and ServiceNow - and backed by NVIDIA, Dell Technologies Capital, Databricks Ventures, Cox Enterprises, and Lionel Messi’s Play Time VC - SuperAnnotate is proud to be the top-ranked AI data company on G2 for multiple consecutive years, including 2025.

### **The Impact You'll Make**

We are looking for a highly analytical, commercially minded Financial Analyst to help build the financial operating backbone of SuperAnnotate as we scale. In this role, you will partner closely with Finance leadership and cross-functional teams to strengthen operational automation, implement internal reporting, improve forecasting accuracy, and deliver insights that directly inform business and GTM decisions.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role at a pivotal stage of the company. You will take existing models, processes and the core financial foundation with the key goal of making it better and more scalable—sharpening how we plan, measure performance, and connect financial outcomes to operational execution. As SuperAnnotate evolves, this role will be deeply embedded in how we think about growth, efficiency, and commercial strategy.

The ideal candidate has strong financial modeling fundamentals, is comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, and is excited to grow into a trusted business partner over time.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in San Francisco.

### **What You'll Do**

* Manage the budgeting and forecasting cadence across the business, partnering with functional leaders to build plans that are accurate, transparent, and tied to operational execution.
* Deliver actionable financial analysis (variance analysis, performance tracking, ROI) that helps leadership understand what’s driving results and what to do next.
* Work closely with Commercial teams (Sales, Operations, Marketing) to support pipeline forecasting, pricing/margin analysis, and GTM strategy decisions.
* Build and maintain metrics dashboards and reporting frameworks that track KPIs, and improve accountability and decision-making.
* Improve and streamline financial processes by developing automation to reduce manual work and increase speed and accuracy.
* Support strategic and ad hoc initiatives including scenario planning, board/investor-ready reporting, new product or market evaluations, and operational efficiency projects as needed.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years of experience in financial analysis, FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a comparable analytical role.
* Strong proficiency in financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis; comfortable building models from scratch and improving existing ones.
* Solid accounting fundamentals and understanding of accrual accounting, revenue recognition concepts, and how financials flow through the books.
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills; ability to work efficiently with large, messy datasets and produce clean outputs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience working in a SaaS, marketplace, AI, or data-driven business
* Exposure to SQL, Python, or BI tools (not required, but a plus)
* Prior experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment

$130,000 - $150,000 a year

In addition to the annual base salary, employees are eligible for an annual bonus paid out quarterly.

Every day we foster an environment where people of all backgrounds not only belong, but excel to succeed as a company and grow together. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
HealthSnap (healthsnap.io) is hiring an FP&A Lead to join a small, high-performing finance team and make an

immediate impact on how we drive margin and profitability.

**About HealthSnap**

HealthSnap provides a remote care management platform built for providers and health systems to manage chronic conditions. We help care teams identify risk earlier, engage patients between visits, and deliver better outcomes at scale. As we grow, we are focused on gross margin expansion and sustainable profitability, and finance is central to how we get there.

**The Role**

As our FP&A Lead, you will be the analytical engine behind our margin and profitability goals. You will turn operational, clinical, and contract data into clear decisions for the executive team and board, and you will have direct exposure to senior leadership from day one. This is not a reporting-only seat. We need someone who finds where margin is leaking, quantifies the opportunity, and works with operators to fix it.

You will join an existing, small finance team and report to the Corporate Controller. Expect broad scope, high visibility, and real ownership.

**What You'll Do**

**Gross margin analysis**

* Build and maintain a detailed gross margin model covering cost of service: devices, cellular connectivity, clinical operations, and logistics.
* Track unit economics per patient and per program, and identify the levers that move margin (device cost, cellular fees, staffing productivity, utilization).
* Partner with Operations, Clinical, and Supply Chain to turn findings into specific initiatives with owners and measurable targets.

**Budgeting, forecasting, and board reporting**

* Support the annual budget and rolling forecasts with driver-based revenue, COGS, and opex models.
* Prepare monthly management reporting and variance analysis that explains what happened, why, and what we are doing about it.
* Build KPI packages, scenario analyses, and supporting materials for executive and board meetings.

**Customer and contract profitability**

* Build customer- and contract-level P&Ls to show which health system relationships, pricing structures, and contract terms drive or erode margin.
* Model the financial impact of contract negotiations, addenda, fee changes, and renewals before they are signed.
* Flag underperforming accounts and recommend pricing or operational responses.

**Pricing and APCM/agentification unit economics**

* Model pricing scenarios and the economics of new care models, including Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM) and agentification (automation of clinical and operational workflows).
* Quantify the margin impact of automation, including cost-to-serve before and after.
* Support go-to-market and product decisions with clear ROI and payback analysis.

**Finance operations partnership**

* Work closely with the Corporate Controller to keep actuals, close processes, and forecasts tightly aligned.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance experience.
* Strong financial modeling skills (three-statement and driver-based) and advanced spreadsheet skills in Google Sheets or Excel.
* Demonstrated experience with gross margin, unit economics, or customer profitability analysis.
* Ability to communicate findings simply and directly to executives and non-finance partners.
* Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward action, and the discipline to get the numbers right.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

**Our stack (familiarity preferred):** QuickBooks, Salesforce, Databricks, Tableau, Coefficient, and Google Workspace.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare, health tech, or RPM, including familiarity with CPT billing codes, Medicare reimbursement, or value-based care economics.
* Experience supporting executive or board reporting.
* Experience in a high-growth or tech-enabled services company with a focus on margin improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 days:** Learn the business and the data. Map the full cost-of-service structure and current margin by customer and program.
* **First 90 days:** Deliver a gross margin bridge and a customer profitability view that leadership uses in decisions. Own the monthly reporting cadence with the Corporate Controller.
* **First 12 months:** Own the budget and forecast process alongside the Controller, and have clear fingerprints on measurable margin improvement and on pricing and contract decisions.

**Compensation and Benefits**

**Base salary range:** $100,000 to $125,000 per year, depending on experience and skills. Fully remote within the US.

Bonus or equity may be considered as part of a total compensation package.

Benefits include health, dental, vision, 401(k), and PTO.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

HealthSnap is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. HealthSnap is unable to provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this position.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
100,000 - 125,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

Own your opportunity to be on the frontlines of health innovation. Deliver for America’s health agency missions and enhance lives for hundreds of millions every day.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are GDIT. We stay at the forefront of innovation to solve complex technical challenges.

GDIT is your place. Make it your own by discovering new ways to apply the latest technology and processes. Own your opportunity at GDIT and you’ll be a meaningful part of improving how agencies operate. Our work depends on a **Patient Safety & Compliance Analyst I** joining our team to lead IT professionals supporting the Health Resources & Services Administration (HRSA).

  
  

The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) aims to improve health outcomes by enhancing access to quality services, developing a skilled health workforce, and implementing innovative programs that benefit geographically isolated, economically or medically vulnerable populations. HRSA focuses on increasing health equity and strengthening local health systems through initiatives such as community health centers, the Organ Procurement & Transplantation Network (OPTN), the Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program, and support for maternal and child health.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an early‑career professional (with up to 4 years of experience) to support Patient Safety, regulatory compliance, documentation, and operational processes. This role is ideal for individuals interested in patient‑safety workflows, technical writing, policy review, and structured data validation.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have **direct experience supporting OPTN (Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network) activities**, including data validation, compliance documentation, or transplant‑related reporting. Experience may come from federal contracting, healthcare analytics, informatics, or clinical quality roles.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

**Patient Safety & Regulatory Support**

* Support case review processes, safety‑related data validation, and accuracy checks across clinical and operational datasets.
* Validate transplant‑related or OPTN‑related records against federal guidelines, ensuring accurate and compliant reporting.
* Contribute to surveillance, monitoring, and safety compliance documentation.

**Technical Writing & Documentation**

* Develop audit‑ready documentation for regulatory reviews, patient‑safety tracking, and internal quality processes.
* Prepare clear summaries, compliance briefs, and policy‑driven documentation for leadership.

**Policy Review & Implementation**

* Assist in reviewing patient‑safety, quality, and regulatory policies and translate them into actionable workflows.
* Support internal process improvements aligned with federal and institutional policy changes.

**Data Entry, Quality Assurance & Reporting**

* Conduct data entry, reconciliation, and validation across multi‑source healthcare systems.
* Support recurring safety and compliance dashboards using tools such as Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or Epic.
* Identify data discrepancies and contribute to root‑cause and corrective‑action analyses.

**Cross‑Team Collaboration**

* Partner with clinical, safety, quality, and analytics teams to support safety initiatives.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non‑technical audiences.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Health Administration, Public Health, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* **3+ years of experience in healthcare data validation, compliance, patient safety, informatics, or quality assurance.**
* **Hands‑on experience supporting the OPTN program or transplant‑related federal reporting workflows is required.**
  + Experience must include:
    - Transplant data validation
    - OPTN modernization support

We are seeking a highly skilled Payroll Tax and Compliance Analyst to oversee payroll employment taxes, regulatory adherence, and mobility compliance across APJ and EMEA regions. **Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

**Background**

UNDP provides integrated programmatic, policy and financing solutions to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). In this context, UNDP has created a Global Policy Network (GPN), a network of field-based and global technical expertise across a wide range of knowledge domains and in support of the signature solutions and organizational capabilities envisioned in the Strategic Plan. The Bureau for Policy and Program Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB) are the two anchor Bureau of the GPN.

In this context, the newly established Governance, Rule of Law, and Peacebuilding (GRP) Hub, a joint endeavor with the Bureau for Policy and Program Support (BPPS) and the Crisis Bureau (CB), provides leadership and advisory services to enhance UNDP’s impact on governance and peacebuilding, ensuring the integration of democratic governance and human rights into crisis response and recovery. The Hub aims to build an integrated portfolio collaboratively between the CB and BPPS and establish partnerships with various stakeholders including the UN System, IFIs, civil society, and the private sector. The Hub’s functions involve providing leadership, advising on strategic positioning, managing global programs, developing GRP solutions, and leading crisis response and recovery support. They also focus on knowledge management and learning, establishing thematic and operational partnerships, and mobilizing resources. Thematic areas include peacebuilding, rule of law, local action, governance, human rights, and democratic institutions. Cross-cutting issues address digital transformation, data for SDG16+, and gender inclusion. The initiative aims to ensure that gender dimensions are systematically and measurably addressed in UNDP's GRP work.

Local and regional governments are already responsible of over 65% of the SDG targets, most of them linked to basic service provision from water, sanitation, mobility, climate action, health or education. Cities and territories are playing a big part on the implementation of SDGs, that are becoming a new tool for strategic planning and budgeting in the mid to long-term. Since 2015, local governments and their associations have been increasingly active in promoting the SDGs through advocacy, working with their local population and partners in transposing the spirit of Agenda 2030 in cities and territories. Local Governments have also started to use SDGs as a strategic framework to deliver better and more innovative public services linked to SDG targets and indicators.

The Procurement Analyst will support participant local and regional governments to improve their PPPs efficiency to align and deliver on Agenda 2030 and will facilitate learning and knowledge generation among municipalities and UNDP country offices around the world.

**Scope of Work**

SDGs are genuinely interlinked with service provision at local level. Across the world, many cities are transforming their approach to service provision. Taking inspiration from the broad spectrum of targets and indicators offered by SDG, cities are introducing innovative practices and rebuilding the concept of social contract from the local level.

The Procurement Analyst will perform the following key duties and accountabilities:

* Ensure full compliance of procurement activities with UN/UNDP rules, regulations, policies, and strategic priorities through effective internal controls and properly used client–oriented procurement management system;
* Elaborate/establish internal procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), map project/s procurement business processes, and manage workflows in Procurement Unit;
* Discuss procurement strategies and plans with projects and other stakeholders and donors to ensure mutual alignment;
* Conceptualizes, elaborates and implements strategic procurement including sourcing strategy, supplier selection and evaluation, quality contract management, contract administration, contract appraisal, cost reduction strategies, customer relationship management, e-procurement, and performance measurement.

**Manage and guide procurement processes for the Business Unit, projects, and other UN Agencies when required:**

* Ensure timely and duly preparation of procurement plans for the Business Unit and projects and monitor their implementation;

* Review and certify submission of documents to internal procurement review committees (CAP, RACP and ACP);

**Stonegate Firm, LLC — Canton, Ohio**

About Stonegate Firm, LLC

Stonegate Firm, LLC is a consumer advocacy company with offices in Canton, Ohio; Atlantic City, New Jersey; and Sheridan, Wyoming. We help consumers legally and permanently exit timeshare contracts. Stonegate Firm is a leading company in the consumer advocacy industry and was ranked No. 18 on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing companies.

We are expanding our in-house marketing team and seeking an experienced, results-driven Media Buyer to manage and scale paid lead generation campaigns.

Position Overview

The Media Buyer will plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns that generate qualified leads and contribute to customer acquisition and revenue growth.

This position will have primary responsibility for day-to-day management of Meta advertising accounts, campaign budgets, testing strategies, performance tracking, and reporting. The Media Buyer will collaborate with marketing, advertising operations, revenue operations, sales, and client service teams to improve lead quality and campaign profitability.

**Work Arrangement:** Remote within the United States, with an optional in-office for candidates located near Canton, Ohio.

* Develop, launch, manage, and optimize lead generation campaigns across Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and additional paid media channels, including Google, TikTok, native advertising, and display.
* Manage advertising budgets, pacing, bidding strategies, and campaign performance to meet cost-per-lead (CPL), cost-per-acquisition (CPA), and return-on-ad-spend (ROAS) goals.

* Analyze lead quality and downstream sales outcomes to identify opportunities for campaign improvement.
* Collaborate with creative and copywriting resources to develop, test, and refresh advertising assets.

* Experience managing substantial monthly advertising budgets. Experience managing more than $500,000 per month in lead generation spend is preferred.
* Working knowledge of advertising tracking and attribution, including Meta Pixel, Conversions API, offline conversion tracking, and CRM attribution.

* Familiarity with advertising platform policies and compliance requirements, including restrictions applicable to regulated industries.

* Ability to communicate campaign performance, business impact, and recommendations clearly to non-marketing stakeholders.

* Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive industry.

* Experience working with advertising operations or revenue operations teams on large-scale marketing data integration, data pipelines, and reporting infrastructure.

OTE is not guaranteed compensation.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

The City Manager’s Office plays a central role in advancing the City of Fremont’s priorities and supporting the delivery of effective municipal services. Working closely with the Mayor and six-member City Council, the Office provides executive leadership, policy support, and coordination across City departments to implement Council priorities and address community needs.

The City Manager’s Office also fosters community partnerships, promotes interagency collaboration, and leads citywide initiatives that strengthen organizational effectiveness and responsiveness. Together, the City Council and City Manager’s Office work to ensure that Fremont remains a vibrant, innovative, and responsive community.

The position involves tracking labor metrics against budget, identifying trends and variances, and supporting forecasting and reporting efforts. It plays a key part in maintaining accurate data, improving reporting processes, and helping leadership address underperforming or over-budget jobs. The role also collaborates closely with operations, finance, and field leadership teams to drive performance improvements while supporting job setup, account onboarding, and ongoing labor planning.

Overall, it’s a data-driven, entry-to-mid level analytical role that blends finance and operations, offering exposure to cross-functional teams and opportunities to grow in workforce planning, performance management, and business analysis.

**Benefit Information:** ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

Pay: $80,000-$100,000  
The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s  
education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.  
You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

* Track and report daily and weekly labor performance vs. budget
* Analyze labor data to identify variances, trends, and cost-saving opportunities
* Support forecasting and monitoring of labor hours, productivity, and expenses
* Assist in identifying and escalating over-budget jobs to leadership
* Maintain accuracy of labor and operational data, including square footage, scope of work, and labor hours
* Support job setup and closeout processes, ensuring proper labor coding and cost tracking
* Assist with onboarding new accounts by validating labor assumptions and inputs
* Monitor overtime, temp labor, and scheduling inefficiencies to identify improvement opportunities
* Participate in performance review processes and help track corrective actions
* Maintain reporting tools, dashboards, and data files to support decision-making
* Ensure data integrity by identifying and resolving discrepancies
* Support process improvements to enhance reporting efficiency and visibility
* Assist with branch and account performance analysis, including identifying drivers of underperformance
* Collaborate with operations and finance teams to support performance improvement efforts
* Provide timely and accurate ad hoc analysis as needed
* Report directly to the Sr Director of Workforce Productivity
* Provide analytical and operational support to the Sr Director of Workforce Productivity
* Partner closely with District Managers and Branch Managers to support day-to-day labor performance and execution
* Collaborate with the FP&A to align reporting, forecasting, and financial insights
* Work cross-functionally with operations and finance teams to support business performance

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related field
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with data tools a plus
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively

**Success Metrics**

* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
* Quality and usefulness of analysis
* Improvement in data integrity and reporting processes
* Contribution to labor cost optimization efforts

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst (Modeling)
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Analyst

***OUR MISSION***

***At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.***

***ABOUT US***

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

***CORE VALUES***

* One Team. One Redwood
* Make Your Own Weather
* Obsess over Customer Success
* Work the Problem
* Be Curious
* Own the Outcome
* Respect Each Other

***YOUR IMPACT***

Join our Finance team as a Senior Financial Analyst focused on financial modeling for a growing infrastructure software business. You will build forecasts and scenario analyses that connect recurring revenue, customer trends, cloud delivery costs and investment decisions to Redwood’s financial outlook. Partner with Finance and business leaders to turn complex data into clear recommendations.

This hands-on role spans annual planning, long-range modeling, performance analysis and executive reporting. Your work will help leadership assess growth opportunities, improve SaaS unit economics and make informed decisions as the business scales.

Financial Modeling & Planning:

Build and maintain integrated financial models for revenue, gross margin, operating expenses and cash flow, with clear assumptions and sensitivity analyses.

Model SaaS revenue drivers, including bookings, renewals, expansion, churn and annual recurring revenue (ARR), in partnership with Sales, Revenue Operations and Finance.

Support annual budgets, rolling forecasts and long-range plans; evaluate scenarios for growth, pricing, customer demand and infrastructure investment.

Performance Analysis:

Analyze actual results against forecast and plan across revenue, cost of revenue and operating expenses; identify the drivers of material variances.

Track SaaS metrics such as ARR, net revenue retention, gross margin and customer economics, and explain what changes mean for future performance.

Prepare concise analyses and presentations that help leadership evaluate trade-offs, risks and opportunities.

**Collaboration & Communication:**

Partner with Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, Product and infrastructure leaders to validate model assumptions and inform business decisions.

Present financial findings clearly to non-financial stakeholders and translate complex analyses into practical recommendations.

Work with the broader Finance team to improve forecasting processes, data quality and consistency in financial reporting.

***YOUR EXPERIENCE***

3–5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, ideally in a SaaS or infrastructure software business

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related field

Experience with Workday or Adaptive Planning is a plus, but not required

Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; ability to work across Google and Microsoft productivity tools

Strong financial modeling skills, including revenue forecasts, scenario analysis and SaaS metrics; experience modeling cloud costs or gross margin is a plus

*If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!*

  

**THE LEGAL BIT**  
Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. We also prohibit discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful and will have a zero tolerance policy applied to it.

  

Redwood will comply with all local data protection laws, including GDPR when it comes to the handling and processing of personal data. Should you wish for us to remove your personal data from our recruitment database, please email us directly at Privacy@Redwood.com

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Finance Analyst - Travel Retail, Americas
jobs.description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns **25** plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in **26** countries, and employs approximately **4,700** people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

Travel Retail is where our brands meet the world on the move, in airports, cruise ships and border shops. This role, based in Miami, is the finance partner behind that regional business. You’ll work closely with the commercial team on pricing, trade terms and investment choices, and see firsthand how each decision shapes the P&L, as part of a global GTR Finance team and a wider community of Camparistas.

**Role Purpose**

As part of the Global Travel Retail Finance team, the Senior Commercial Finance Analyst supports the financial management of the Regional P&L down to CAAP. The role acts as a true Business Partner, working closely with the Regional Travel Retail Commercial Director and the regional commercial team, providing timely analysis, insights and financial recommendations to support sustainable and profitable growth. The position plays an important role in planning, performance analysis, revenue optimisation, investment effectiveness and financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities and Activities**

* **Financial forecasting & budgeting**: Participate in the monthly S&OP cycle, translating volume forecasts into financial projections down to CAAP. Provide analysis, insights and recommendations, and identify, quantify and monitor regional year-to-go risks and opportunities
* **Gross to Net:** Support Revenue Optimization by customers, channel and brand to improve revenue performance and maximize profitability through:
  + Developing and maintaining Value chains by customer, channel, location and brand,
  + Supporting development of pricing corridors in collaboration with commercial team
  + Monitoring pricing execution against the agreed strategy
  + Supporting the commercial team in trade term negotiations, including the preparation of price letters
* Monitor **A&P** investment by customer, location, channel and brand, ensuring accurate tracking and visibility of spend
* Prepare **ROI** analyses for key initiatives, identify opportunities to improve investment effectiveness and share relevant learnings
* **Partner** with the Regional commercial and CCM team on key projects, particularly innovation initiatives
* Collaborate with Regional Supply Chain Finance to understand COGS evolution
* **Process improvement**: contribute to automation, reporting simplification and stronger use of available systems and data, in collaboration with the broader GTR finance team

**Expected deliverables:**

* Ensure that financial submissions down to CAAP are accurate, complete and on time
* Provides analysis, insights and recommendations
* Supports and constructively challenges commercial teams
* Maintains data quality and financial discipline

**Experience Required**

* 5-8 years-experience working closely with Sales & Marketing in a commercial finance capacity
* Degree in Commerce/Accounting/CPA
* Experience in Liquor industry preferred, FMCG essential
* Advanced Excel and Strong PowerPoint skills

**Skills Required**

* Strong analytical, data analysis and financial reporting skills
* Highly developed interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work in cross-functional and matrix organizations
* Strong planning, organizational and decision-making skills
* Commercial acumen to understand business goals
* Strong attention to details with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Allia Health Group**
============================

Allia Health Group is a fast-growing digital health system revolutionizing metabolic, hormonal, and longevity care. As the parent organization behind Brello Health (women's telehealth and longevity programs), HelloWellness (men's telehealth), Southend Pharmacy (a state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacy), and Zito Care (our healthcare provider network), we deliver seamless, end-to-end care powered by a shared technology and AI platform.

We remove barriers so clinicians can focus on patients and patients can access personalized, proactive care on their own terms — whether through telehealth visits, compounded medications, lab testing, wellness support, and more, all in one connected experience across 35+ states.

Allia is building the future of healthcare by being clinician-first and patient-centered. We are innovative, empathetic, and accessible to our patients, combining cutting-edge tools with human-centered care to make high-quality longevity and wellness solutions affordable and available to more people.

**Position Overview**

This role supports the day-to-day operation of the company's SOC 2 program, and over time will help build out our ISO 42001 AI Management System (AIMS) and AI governance program.

The immediate priority is keeping SOC 2 controls, evidence, and remediation on track throughout the year, not just ahead of audit season. The analyst will work with IT (including the CTO/CISO and their team), Security, HR, Legal, and other control owners to turn compliance requirements into concrete tasks, keep evidence current, flag gaps early, and keep the organization audit-ready on an ongoing basis.

The role reports to the Chief Compliance Officer, who retains ownership of the compliance program. The analyst operationalizes and maintains technology-related controls alongside IT while providing independent compliance oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

*SOC 2 & continuous compliance*

* Coordinate evidence collection, validation, and remediation across control owners; follow up on overdue or incomplete items.
* Maintain audit readiness year-round rather than treating SOC 2 as an annual exercise.
* Identify control gaps, exceptions, and deficiencies, and coordinate remediation with the responsible team.
* Support SOC 2 Type 2 audit fieldwork and auditor requests.
* Escalate overdue or material issues to the CCO and relevant IT/business leadership.

*Drata administration*

* Operate and maintain Drata day to day, including API integrations and automated evidence sources.
* Investigate and remediate failed automated tests and compliance exceptions.
* Keep evidence complete, accurate, and correctly mapped to controls.
* Look for ways to automate manual evidence collection and cut recurring effort.

*ISO 42001 & AI governance*

* Support building the AIMS: policies, procedures, controls, risk assessments, and supporting documentation.
* Help build and maintain an inventory of AI systems, applications, and use cases.
* Coordinate AI risk and impact assessments, control activities, and evidence collection.
* Work with IT and business stakeholders to put AI governance requirements into practice.
* Support future ISO 42001 readiness assessments and certification work.

*SaaS & vendor governance*

* Maintain the SaaS/technology inventory.
* Support security and compliance reviews for new and existing vendors (SOC reports, questionnaires, certifications, contract requirements).
* Track vendor compliance gaps and remediation, and keep related evidence current for SOC 2 and applicable ISO 42001 requirements.

*Risk management*

* Maintain the risk register and coordinate periodic updates with risk owners.
* Support information security, technology, third-party, and AI-related risk assessments.
* Facilitate quarterly access reviews and track completion and remediation.
* Escalate material or overdue risks to the CCO and appropriate leadership.

*Audit readiness*

* Organize and maintain documentation for SOC 2 and ISO 42001 assessments.
* Coordinate responses to auditor and assessor requests, and maintain audit trails.
* Track findings and corrective actions through closure.

*Reporting*

* Build monthly compliance and IT dashboards for leadership: MFA coverage, access review completion, onboarding/offboarding SLAs, evidence completion, remediation status, vendor reviews, and trends.
* Surface upcoming deadlines, overdue items, and risks that need management attention.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years in compliance, GRC, information security, IT audit, or risk management.
* Working knowledge of SOC 2 and information security controls.
* Experience with a GRC/continuous compliance platform (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe, or similar).
* Experience coordinating evidence collection and remediation across technical and business teams.
* Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Able to work independently, spot gaps, and drive issues to resolution.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting ISO 42001 or another AI management system.
* Experience with AI governance, AI risk assessments, or emerging technology risk.
* HIPAA or healthcare compliance experience, ideally in a technology or regulated environment.
* ISO 27001 or other ISO management-system experience.
* CISA, CISM, CRISC, Security+, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001 certification or training.

**What success looks like**

Continuous SOC 2 readiness, evidence and remediation completed on time, clear accountability among control owners, and fewer items requiring manual escalation. Over time, a working foundation for ISO 42001 and AI governance: a documented AI inventory, risks, controls, and ongoing monitoring.

**What We Offer:**

* Full benefits package including medical, vision, dental, 401(k) with company match, PTO, Flex days, holidays, and more!

*All

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Procurement Analyst supports logistics operations for four USCIS regions and 130 geographically dispersed USCIS ASC locations. Reporting to the Senior Manager, this role provides comprehensive project management support across key logistics functions, including procurement, property control, FAR compliance, SOP development, and funds expenditure control.

In the absence of the Senior Logistics Manager, this position serves as the primary point of contact, ensuring continuity of operations and decision-making. Additionally, the role ensures strict adherence to Quality Assurance policies, organizational goals, and Environmental Health & Safety standards in all procurement and logistics processes.

**Position Accountabilities**

* Analyze procurement metrics, including cost savings, supplier performance, and spend analysis, to generate reports and dashboards that provide insights to leadership and support data-driven decision-making and process improvements.
* Monitors Purchasing activities with the Senior Logistics Manager to ensure expeditious requirements fills, to include proper coding to Accounts Payable (AP).
* Review, verify, and reconcile invoices against contracts, purchase orders, and delivery records to ensure accuracy and prevent overpayments.
* Works the inventory management program, maintaining the master inventory records for all site locations, to include disposal requirements IAW regulations and procedures
* Coordinates quarterly property inventory audits with all sites, updates master inventory records and provides property accountability changes, additions and deletions to the Property Custodian.
* Assists in managing site relocations and expansions, in close coordination with the Facilities Department, Senior Logistics Manager and Site and Regional Managers.
* Coordinates logistics requirements with selected vendors regarding new property and furniture purchase, move/relocation requirements and applicable disposal requirements.
* Initiates Requests for Quotation (RFP) and Requests for Proposal (RFP) to Corporate Global Supplies Chain Management (GSCM) Buyers.
* Responsible for the adherence to all Amentum policies and procedures, to include applicable GSCM, Accounts Payable (AP) and USCIS policies/procedures.

**Minimum requirements**

* 4 yrs of procurement experience. This shall include property and supply procurement functions.
* Associate's degree

**Skills & Core Competencies**

If you're searching for a place where you can grow, continue learning, and make a meaningful impact while still having time for the people and moments that matter most, welcome to Integrated Power Services! We believe your value extends far beyond your job title because the best work comes from people who feel supported, challenged, and fulfilled both professionally and personally. Here, you'll find opportunities to develop your career, work alongside exceptional teammates, and be part of a culture that recognizes that your life is worth just as much as your work—if not more. Because when people thrive, businesses thrive. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we invite you to join us!

**Benefits:**

* Paid Time Off (PTO)

* Bonus Incentives
* Extensive Training & Career Development Programs
* Tuition Reimbursement Program
* Medical, Dental and Vision plans
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

**Responsibilities & Expectations:**

The Strategic Sourcing Buyer represents the centralized supply chain function and is responsible for sourcing materials, equipment, and services that keep IPS locations and customers running. This role leads competitive sourcing events, negotiates pricing and commercial terms, and leverages spend across regions in partnership with regional buyers. The Strategic Sourcing Buyer works within the national agreement structure and category management framework to deliver measurable savings, supplier performance, and supply continuity.

**Sourcing and negotiation**

* Lead requests for quotation (RFQs) and requests for proposal (RFPs), from specification through award.
* Evaluate and qualify suppliers on price, quality, delivery, capability, financial stability, and risk.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, warranties, and other commercial terms that protect IPS and its customers.
* Prepare sourcing recommendations supported by total cost analysis and clear rationale.

**National agreements and category management**

* **Required.** Follow the national agreement structures and category management strategies established by IPS. Source within these agreements and align purchasing decisions to them.
* Partner with centralized category management to develop, maintain, and improve national agreements.
* Identify when a requirement falls outside an existing agreement and raise it to category management for review.

**Regional leverage and supply chain representation**

* Leverage spend across regions by coordinating with regional buyers to consolidate volume and secure better terms.
* Serve as the supply chain representative for the centralized supply chain function with internal stakeholders and suppliers.
* Understand the IPS business and its key customers, and prioritize sourcing activity to support their uptime and reliability needs.

**Supplier performance and risk**

* Monitor supplier performance against delivery, quality, pricing, and service expectations.
* Communicate supplier risk, cost opportunities, and sourcing recommendations to internal stakeholders.
* Lead corrective action and supplier improvement efforts when performance falls short.

**Cost savings**

* Identify, validate, and track cost savings opportunities, including spend consolidation, supplier alternatives, specification changes, and process improvements.
* Report savings and sourcing results to supply chain leadership.

**Cross-functional collaboration**

* **Operations.** Understand location and field service needs, and align supply plans to demand.
* **Engineering.** Confirm specifications, qualify alternate sources, and evaluate technical requirements.
* **Quality.** Support supplier qualification, audits, and nonconformance resolution.
* **Finance.** Align on budgets, payment terms, savings validation, and spend reporting.
* **Category management.** Coordinate category strategies, national agreements, and supplier selection.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, supply chain, or a related field.
* Three to seven years of purchasing, procurement, and strategic sourcing experience.
* Experience with automation tools and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence internal stakeholders and suppliers.
* Experience managing sourcing across multiple locations or in a multi-site business.

**Preferred**

* Engineering degree.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and how they apply to sourcing and procurement.

* **Value teamwork and accountability.** You work well with others, take responsibility, serve others, and deliver on your commitments.
* **Focus on the customer.** You are dedicated to providing an unmatched customer experience and exceeding expectations.
* **Have an entrepreneurial spirit.** You’re proactive, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* **Communicate effectively and with purpose.** You keep everyone informed with clear, concise communication.

At IPS, we're committed to empowering you to make a meaningful impact. We serve over 40,000 essential customer locations, from renewable energy pioneers to hospitals, manufacturers, and municipalities, helping them avoid costly downtime and ensure mission-critical operations.

jobs.title: Retail Buyer
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Training & development
* Vision insurance
* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discounts
* Flexible schedule

**WAGE RANGE: $17.40-$20.40 per hour**  
  
**The Resale Revolution Starts With You!**

As a Crossroads Buyer, you will bring our brand promise to life: to offer a fun, fashion-centered, and affordable shopping experience to our communities. You’ll hand select items to sell in our stores and provide a high-level of customer service. You’ll get customers excited about shopping and selling second-hand fashion, whether it’s their first time or their 1000th!

When you join Crossroads, you are joining the sustainable fashion movement and reshaping fashion culture. And you aren’t just impacting the planet’s future- you are impacting your own.

* We have clear paths for promotion and several routes you can take as you embark on your second-hand retail journey.
* You’ll learn how to run a second-hand business– you’ll embody an entrepreneurial spirit- learning everything from buying, merchandising and inventory practices to gaining and maintaining the trust of a customer base who has been devoted since day one.

**You are:**

* **A Team Player**. You are as enthusiastic about the success of others as you are about your own success.
* **Authentic**. You are your unique self!
* **Fashion-focused.** You eat, breathe, and sleep style. Fashion is life.
* **Adaptable**. You feel comfortable adjusting to changing circumstances and encourage your teammates to do the same. We problem-solve together!
* **People**-**first**. You are energized by people. You radiate kindness and positivity! You understand your impact and are someone who uplifts others.

**You will:**

* **Engage**. You get to meet new people, every day! Greet each customer with a smile and welcome them to our store. Create a welcoming, fun, and inclusive environment to shop and work in.
* **Ask and Educate**. You will teach our customers how we work and get them excited about selling their clothes to us!
* **Have Integrity**. You will act with integrity in words and actions- do the right thing and do it right, even when it’s difficult.
* **Be Compassionate**. You will embody our core values of service, inclusion, and education. It’s important that we connect with all customers and try our best to help them.
* **Be Reliable**. You will show up to work on time and ready to go!
* **Be Flexible**. You understand that needs change and evolve throughout the day- you know how to support your team and customer as needed.
* **Enjoy Organizing.** Cleaning, organizing, and merchandising are all parts of the job and help create the best possible shopping and working environment.

**Perks:**

**Health + Wellbeing**

**We will:**

* **Support your wellbeing**. We care about our employees holistically and offer sick paid time off.
* **Prioritize wellness for all.** We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance for ALL employees who work at least 20 hours a week!

**Work/Life Harmony**

**We will:**

* **Give you incentives when you work during the holidays.** We pay time and a half on select holidays throughout the year, and we are closed on Thanksgiving and Christmas.
* **Encourage work/life balance.** We offer flexible scheduling so that you can meet work & life needs!

**Financial Health**

**We will:**

* **Contribute to your 401(k)**. Free money? We’ll match up to 4% of your contribution as soon as you enroll & an additional discretionary 2% at year-end! We offer both a Roth and traditional 401(k).
* **Offer** a generousdiscount on all merchandise including luxury consignment pieces- shop where you work!
* **Be Transparent.** We have clear pay ranges and always advertise pay for positions. We believe in pay equity.
* **Offer Earned Wage Access.** Need money before payday? You’ll be able to access pay as you earn it through our partner app ZayZoon
* **Contribute** **to Commuter Benefits**. Take public transit? We’ll contribute and match a portion of your commuter account monthly.

**Growth + Development**

**We will:**

* **Let you take the lead.** We offer clear paths for growth and ongoing professional development that are straightforward and attainable.
* **Celebrate with you**. We’ll provide you with many opportunities to bond with your team as you celebrate successes together.
* **Equip you with the tools to be successful**. As you onboard & throughout your career, our training programs will set you up to win.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Must be able to work a minimum of 12 hours per week.
* 6+ months of retail experience.
* Have a good eye for fashion and current trends.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

**About Crossroads**

One of the first companies to pioneer secondhand clothing as an alternative to traditional retail, Crossroads Trading has been buying, selling, and consigning name brand and designer clothing in a friendly, fun, and fashionable atmosphere since 1991.

Since opening the doors of its first location in the heart of San Francisco’s Fillmore District, Crossroads has expanded over time to 38 retail locations spanning Northern and Southern California, Chicago, Seattle, Portland, Denver, New York, and Houston. And in recent years, we have added Sell-By-Mail and Concierge programs to provide convenient new ways for fashionable and eco-conscious customers to sell their gently used clothing.

Crossroads has been featured in Harper’s Bazaar, Teen Vogue, and LA Mag, and is widely recognized as an industry leader in the ‘resale revolution.’

**If you like sustainability, fashion, and working in a fun, positive environment, you’ll enjoy a career with us!**

CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. **Role Overview:**

FP&A owns the long-range plan, the company-wide forecast, and the board and investor materials. As department count and spend grow with headcount, this role gives each partner area a dedicated finance partner. As an FP&A Analyst, you'll serve as a business partner to functional leaders (e.g., Engineering, G&A and S&M leaders), tracking spend, forecasting, and explaining what's driving the numbers. Coverage areas may change as the company scales.

**Ownership over:**

* Rolling forecast inputs from partner areas to the company-wide forecast
* Monthly variance reporting for your partner areas
* Monthly headcount cost reconciliation with People Ops
* Partner reporting and dashboards, built on the Datarails platform

**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with functional leaders on budget ownership, headcount and vendor spend decisions, and resource tradeoffs
* Translate current and past financial and operational data into clear recommendations for functional leaders
* Build and maintain recurring analyses for partner areas
* Identify and implement process improvements to streamline manual workflows and enhance reporting accuracy

**Areas of accountability:**

* Own the monthly forecast and budget-to-actual inputs for your partner areas
* Develop your partner areas' inputs to the company-wide forecast and annual plan
* Track actuals against plan, identify variances, and drive root-cause conversations with partners
* Prepare analysis and talking points for leadership, and support board and investor materials as needed

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or other related field, or equivalent work experience
* 2+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, or a related analytical role, supporting forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis
